entry.title: Point4D: Long-range 4D Motion Reconstruction

entry.title: The GNU strip backdoor is the case AI code review can't see
entry.summary: This paper (arxiv 2607.24888) is worth a stop if you evaluate AI code review. It shows Ken Thompson's trusting-trust attack is not compiler-specific: the authors pull it off with GNU strip, a build utility that neither reads nor generates source, using only tampered finished ELF binaries.
